name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Over 28 days, Quality HVAC by Fibid generated 27 leads at a $62.52 CPL across $1,688.09 in spend, with GBP driving strong offline intent (121 actions, 15 calls, 75 directions). The biggest movement is Instagram's 28.02% spend drop over the last 7 days, likely reflecting a budget pullback or paused creative, while Search Campaigns offset this with a 15.38% spend increase, suggesting a deliberate shift toward higher-intent channels.

performance.verdict: 9 overdue milestones — not an ads problem, an ops and build problem.

findings.text: 9 SOW milestones overdue by up to 80 days: intake owner, heating campaigns, LSA re-enable, booking bot, review boost, financing page, Homer Glen branch, heating content, fall creative — all unresolved.
CPL is uncomputable for the last 7d: leads_7d_pct is null, meaning 0 leads tracked this window against ~$375 spend — efficiency cannot be confirmed.

3-day lead signal (Oct 16–18) shows 11 leads vs 1 lead in prior 3 days (Oct 13–15) — a positive spike, but GHL shows 0 appointments booked against 769 opportunities created, suggesting intake capture is not converting.
GBP actions hit 0 for the last 3 days (Oct 16–18), down from 16 on Oct 12–13 — organic offline intent has gone dark at the start of heating season.
Instagram reach dropped 28.02% week-over-week; daily reach fell from ~40 avg in late Sept to 19–22 in Oct 16–17 — consistent with paused or fatigued creative, not a budget anomaly.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner has active GHL login; 0 appointments vs 769 opportunities is a confirmed intake leak blocking all lead value.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and intake ownership is unconfirmed per the SOW — this is a priority-2 overdue milestone from Aug 31. GHL shows 769 opportunities created but 0 appointments booked in the 28-day window, meaning leads are arriving but no one is capturing them into bookings. Action: Nacer to confirm who owns intake today, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is in place. Success check: at least 1 appointment logged in GHL by 2026-10-22.

suggestions.text: Escalate LSA re-enable and heating campaign launch — both overdue since Sept 1 and Oct 1; heating season spend is live but campaigns are not.
suggestions.monday_update: LSA re-enable (heating toggles) was due Sept 1 and heating campaigns on Google and Meta were due Oct 1 — both are confirmed overdue milestones. The account is currently spending ~$53.59/day with no confirmed leads in the last 7-day window, meaning heating-season budget is running without the intended campaign structure. Action: Ads team to confirm whether BWS-Heating-Search-Calls (currently top campaign at $515.31/28d) covers this milestone or if a separate heating campaign launch is still pending; LSA heating toggle status must be confirmed with client. Success check: written confirmation of LSA toggle state and heating campaign status by 2026-10-22.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 3 consecutive days (Oct 16–18) — re-check Oct 22 before attributing to Windsor lag vs real drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been 0 for the last 3 days (Oct 16–18), down from a peak of 16 on Oct 12–13.
